Chapter 299: Chapter 7: The Legacy of the Eighth Layer Evolver (Subscription Requested)

The strong members of the Heiyuan Clan within the valley were in high spirits.

They had originally planned to report this spatial entrance to their clan, since even a small share was much better than nothing.

But now, they had unexpectedly discovered a member of the Human Race actively approaching them.

If they could control this human, force him into the spatial entrance,

with his identity as part of the same race as the owner of the spatial entrance, they should easily be able to bring out all the treasures.

At that time, they could solely enjoy the treasures stored inside this spatial entrance.

...

“Don’t get too excited too soon.”

“First, determine the strength and number of humans in this spaceship.”

Captain Wei Qing had not relaxed his vigilance. On the Battlefields of Different Races, any slight oversight could cost them their lives.

Compared to the Human Race and the Insect Race and other Peak Clans who could be resurrected,

the life of their mighty clans was truly over upon death—the clans would not pay a heavy price to ask the Peak Clans to resurrect them.

“Okay.”

A member of the Heiyuan Clan, with skin of a bluish hue, took out a sky-blue gemstone.

Immediately, he aimed one side of the gemstone at the swiftly approaching dark, streamlined spaceship.

Hum.

A slight vibration spread outwards.

This sky-blue gemstone, bestowed by the Insect Race, was used to detect the surrounding environment and gauge the levels and numbers of enemy combatants.

On the Battlefields of Different Races, it’s difficult to kill alien strong ones of the same level, and similarly hard to overpower and kill those weaker than oneself.

One reason is the presence of this type of detection gemstone.

A Seventh Rank Evolver trying to disguise oneself as Sixth Rank and then slaughter within the ranks of the weaker Different Species was practically impossible,

because the vast majority of Seventh Rank Evolvers could not escape the detection of this gemstone.

“Captain, there’s only one person in the spaceship, and he has not reached the Seventh Rank.”

The blue-skinned member of the Heiyuan Clan opened his eyes and spoke.

“Not having reached the Seventh Rank is fine.”

Captain Wei Qing nodded slightly.

All of them were at the peak of the Sixth Rank, with him, Wei Qing, being at the pinnacle of that peak. Together, capturing a Human Race Sixth Rank Evolver would not be difficult.

…

Lin Yuan piloted the spaceship into the Battlefields of Different Races, being extremely cautious, to the extent that he didn’t even use Wormhole Shuttle.

On the Battlefields of Different Races, spatial fluctuations were significant, making precise travel through Wormhole Shuttle impossible.

Moreover, using Wormhole Shuttle stirred up minor spatial fluctuations, easily drawing the attention of alien strong ones.

“In the Battlefields of Different Races, if I’m lucky, I might not even encounter any Different Species.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. The Battlefields of Different Races were vast, spanning 0.2 light-years in diameter—a range so immense that even placing hundreds of billions of Evolvers inside would be like a drop in the ocean.

“It’s best I don’t encounter any Different Species. I have no interest in them.”

Lin Yuan thought,

battling with the Different Species, even against the weakest among them,

still carried the risk of failure.

Lin Yuan’s primary aim in entering the Battlefields of Different Races was to head toward that Eternal Spatial Rift to comprehend the Space Rules emanating from it,

allowing him to thoroughly understand the remaining fundamental spatial models and step into the Seventh Stage Martial Tao realm.

“Huh?”

Lin Yuan’s expression suddenly changed.

Just a moment ago, he sensed a faint fluctuation sweep across the spaceship.

“Are there Different Species?”

Lin Yuan’s expression turned serious.

He was just about to slow down the spaceship,

but suddenly,

a terrifying wave of energy descended.

The spaceship Lin Yuan was in exploded instantly.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared not far away.

At the same time,

several members of the Heiyuan Clan immediately surrounded him.

“Not bad, in terms of strength.”

Heiyuan Clan Captain Wei Qing eyed Lin Yuan.

The strike just now had pierced through the spaceship, and he had thought that Lin Yuan would at least be injured,

but it seemed now that his strength was even beyond their estimates.

However, Captain Wei Qing was unfazed. With that probing attack, he had already confirmed that Lin Yuan was not a Seventh Rank Evolver.

Since that was the case,

then it was simple.

“Different Species?”

Lin Yuan looked around at the Heiyuan Clan strong ones gathering.

“They don’t want to kill me?”

Lin Yuan pondered thoughtfully, sensing the strength of these Heiyuan Clan members, knowing that if they had been serious, it definitely wouldn’t have been as simple as before.

“Human Race.”

“If you want to live, listen to us.”

A member of the Heiyuan Clan spoke up, thinking they had the upper hand at this moment.

“What must I do to live?”

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred, following the other’s words.

Normally, on the Battlefields of Different Races, when the Human Race encountered the Heiyuan Clan, there would be no talking, only immediate battle.

Human Race, killing members of the Heiyuan Clan, would earn treasure and Merit Points rewards.

The Heiyuan Clan killing members of the Human Race would likewise earn rewards from their own clan, and possibly even gifts from the Insect Race.

So,

unless there were other motives,

the two great clans would definitely start fighting upon meeting.

“It’s simple…”

“First, stop resisting.”

Another member of the Heiyuan Clan started to approach.

“You have to promise you’ll let me go…” Lin Yuan spoke softly.

“Of course.”

A smile surfaced on the face of the approaching Heiyuan Clan member.

The other Heiyuan Clan members’ expressions, however, bore a hint of scorn.

In this inter-clan war, to actually believe the promise of a Different Species was naive—this Human Race Evolver was most likely a novice in war.

The next moment,

Lin Yuan’s figure vanished from the spot.

Simultaneously, for miles around, everything was engulfed by Taiyang True Fire, the terrifying heat beginning to burn the air, burning everything.

“Not good.”

The expressions of the several Heiyuan Clan members turned to alarm.
